div.div: 'You can download the requested Board Resolution here'

ul.li: The resolution must be signed by all authorized individuals (all shareholders).

The wording of the resolution clauses must not be altered under any circumstances. The template is a legally approved format by SPC Free Zone, and only the highlighted fields are intended for completion.
The resolution must be typed on the official company letterhead. Submissions not on letterhead shall be deemed invalid and subject to rejection.

Where multiple Directors or Managers are involved, only additional rows may be inserted below the existing table in the same format. The clause must not be modified. A maximum of four (4) Directors or Managers is permitted.
All names, passport numbers, and nationalities must exactly match the official documents. Screenshots, cropped images, or pictures of signatures and stamps are strictly prohibited.
If the resolution continues onto a second page, it must also be printed on the company's letterhead. Signatures and stamps must not appear alone on any page.

The final document must be fully completed, printed, and stamped using accepted methods — Ink/Wet Stamp or Digital Stamp. A handwritten (wet) signature or an authenticated online signature (e.g., UAE PASS, Adobe Sign, DocuSign) is required. Snipped signatures or stamps are strictly prohibited. Draft or partially completed documents will not be accepted.

div.label: I confirm that I have read and understood all of the above requirements and will ensure full compliance.
